name: ready-prs
description: Shows the repository's open pull requests that are ready to merge, and the ones waiting for your review, just above the prompt

readiness.title: Readiness rule
readiness.description: clean: GitHub reports the PR as CLEAN. clean-or-unstable: also count PRs whose only failures are optional checks. approved: CLEAN and approved by a reviewer.

scope.title: Which PRs
scope.description: all: every open PR in the repository. mine: only PRs you opened (gh's signed-in account).

reviews.title: Show review requests
reviews.description: Add a line for open PRs waiting for your review, and show the band for them even when nothing is ready to merge.

maxRows.title: Rows shown
maxRows.description: How many ready PRs the band lists before it says +N more (1 to 10).

pollMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often the mod asks GitHub again. /ready-prs checks right away.
